caption: A battery pack is clipped into a cordless drill and the trigger pulled, and the drill bit spins.

sa.check: A cordless drill with a bit in its chuck, and a separate battery pack.
The battery pack is clipped into the drill.
No cord runs from the drill.
The order is pack in, trigger pulled, bit spins.

pc.expect: The bit starts turning when the trigger is pulled with the pack seated, and only then.
pc.fail: The trigger is pulled with the pack in and the bit stays still; or the bit spins before the trigger is pulled; or the bit spins with the pack lying loose beside the drill.

pc.expect: The bit turns only while the trigger is held: it stops when the trigger is released and does not start, stop or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: The bit stops dead and restarts while the trigger is held steady; or reverses direction on its own; or keeps spinning to the end of the clip after the finger has lifted off the trigger.

pc.expect: The bit spins about its own axis, held in the chuck; chuck and bit turn together.
pc.fail: The bit wobbles off its axis or bends while turning; or the chuck turns while the bit stays still; or the bit turns while the chuck is still; or the whole drill body spins with the bit.

pc.expect: The pack slides onto the drill as a rigid block and seats with a stop; drill and pack keep their shapes.
pc.fail: The pack squashes or bends as it goes in; or the drill handle deforms around it; or the pack hangs a gap away from the drill once clipped.

pc.expect: One drill, one pack, one bit; the pack stays clipped once in and fingers stay outside the drill.
pc.fail: The pack vanishes after clipping in or a second pack appears; or the bit vanishes or a second bit appears; or the pack passes into the handle rather than onto it; or fingers pass through the drill.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The drill's colour, the pack's label and the bench stay the same.
pc.fail: The drill changes colour; or the bit changes length or type; or items on the bench rearrange.
